findings.title: 赛事已暂停后其他桌异常关闭被拒绝，回滚离席释放并阻止玩家转入其他匹配
findings.evidence: 实际PlatformService内存建立16人固定赛事和四个真实assignment，四桌均claim game-start。第一桌合法empty-timeout关闭令run.phase=blocked并释放4人。其他桌room-closed先修改feed/match/participant并删除active索引，随后blockTournamentAssignment因run不再round-active抛RUN_NOT_ACTIVE，整事务回滚。已审生产expiry/close会为未正常结束的空房发同类事件并回收本地room；不需要无效票据或伪造身份。
findings.validation: node docs/audit/2026-09-12/repro/tournament-progression-11.mjs：分别让4张桌先关闭，4/4首闭成功且重复幂等；每次其余3桌各两次合法关闭均拒绝，状态完全未变，12个active用户仍在playing；其首用户新quick被ALREADY_MATCHING拒绝，通用cancel被MATCH_NOT_CANCELLABLE拒绝。各fixture重建MemoryPlatformStore+PlatformService后仍拒绝。首闭桌用户作为对照可进入quick。未执行真实16WS断连计时，没声称全平台队列阻塞或永久不可恢复。
findings.recommendation: 把赛事暂停决策和逐桌资源/身份收尾解耦。run已blocked时仍校验当前赛事/轮次/assignment/match绑定，并原子接收其他已分配桌的合法关闭、释放该桌成员和记录幂等回执；保留首次阻断原因和既有成绩，不自动补赛、晋级或改分。补两桌以上先后/并发终止、回调重试和冷恢复回归。

limitations: Only nine full-read files are counted. Config/runtime/result/metadata and frontend controller/model were supporting reads, not added to coverage.

Normal full tournament HTTP contract and extra terminal result fixtures use synthetic users and memory; not actual 27-card games, 16 sockets, production JSON crash recovery or mobile verification. Full HTTP/config boundaries remain tracked separately.
Pausing on a broken table is intentional. Finding concerns later room cleanup rollback and stale active user bindings, not the lack of automatic tournament restart or all later score refusal.
Legacy catalog and paid tournament operations, source tests beyond selected five, client lifecycle/rendering remain pending. Signing/ticket imports do not themselves count as full crypto review.
